title: Manifesto per un'agenda Tax the Rich per l'Italia (134 economisti di 50 università)
notes: Presented at the Senate on 22 May 2024 with Oxfam Italia and Patriotic Millionaires; calls for a progressive wealth tax on the richest 0.1% (net wealth > EUR 5.4m).

title: Emendamento Orfini-Fratoianni alla Legge di Bilancio 2021 (imposta progressiva sui grandi patrimoni)
notes: Budget amendment proposing a progressive wealth tax from 0.2% over EUR 500k to 2% over EUR 50m (3% over EUR 1bn for 2021), replacing IMU and stamp duty on bank/securities accounts.

title: Proposta di legge di iniziativa popolare 1% Equo ("Imposta grandi patrimoni") — primi firmatari
notes: Filed at the Court of Cassation on 7 May 2026; proposes a 1% to 3.5% progressive annual wealth tax on net wealth over EUR 2m (excluding primary residence).

title: Comitato 1% Equo — elenco completo sottoscrittori accademici, politici e artisti su unpercentoequo.it
notes: JS-rendered endorsement roster on unpercentoequo.it (academics, artists, politicians); harvest in R002 with individual readable sources.

title: Campagna Sbilanciamoci! — 54 organizzazioni aderenti (Controfinanziaria)
notes: Coalition of 54 civil-society organisations; verify which member organisations independently endorse the Controfinanziaria wealth tax proposal in R002.

title: Iniziativa dei Cittadini Europei Tax the Rich (#LaGrandeRicchezza) — promotori e testimonial italiani
